copias_ejecutar_alcance: Local test with synthetic data. This does not enable restoration in production.
copias_ejecutar_argumentos: Provide the private configuration file for the test.
copias_ejecutar_configuracion: The private configuration could not be checked. Review the file and its permissions.
copias_ejecutar_origen: The test database could not be prepared. Check the local environment and try again.
copias_ejecutar_preparada: The local synthetic database is ready. Measure its components before requesting a backup.
copias_ejecutar_medida: The local database and files were measured. Prepare the descriptor and check that it matches before copying.
copias_ejecutar_exclusion: The test database could not be reserved for verification. Check the test processes.
copias_ejecutar_inventario: The inventory does not match the observed database and files. Review the private descriptor.
copias_ejecutar_contraste: The full contents of the test database could not be read. Review the test permissions.
copias_ejecutar_observada: The synthetic source was checked while changes were excluded. You can now request the backup.
copias_ejecutar_dependencia: A component needed to verify the backup is missing. Review the test configuration.
copias_ejecutar_fallida: The backup could not be verified. Check the private test log before trying again.
copias_ejecutar_completada: The synthetic backup was verified with physical and logical restores and an application startup check.
